raw_text: पाकिस्तान से आया ड्रोन अमृतसर के पास गिराया गया। 5 किलो हेरोइन बरामद। यह इस हफ्ते का तीसरा ड्रोन है। Pakistani drone from Kasur district shot down near Amritsar. Narco payload of 5 kg heroin recovered. BSF sources say the launch point was identified in Kasur, Pakistan. Intelligence agencies tracking the network. Anti-drone grid being strengthened.
clean_text: Pakistani drone from Kasur shot down near Amritsar with 5kg heroin. Third this week. BSF identified launch point in Kasur. Anti-drone grid being strengthened.
